theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_regular_component_structure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : IMRep U (m + 1)) (y : Euclid P), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → y ∈ regularSet T → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T₁ ω = ∫ x in connectedComponentIn (regularSet T) y, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]) → MeasurableSet (connectedComponentIn (regularSet T) y) ∧ μHE[m + 1] (connectedComponentIn (regularSet T) y \ R.carrier) = 0 ∧ closure (connectedComponentIn (regularSet T) y) ∩ U ⊆ connectedComponentIn (regularSet T) y ∪ singularSet T ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IsCompact (singularSet T ∩ K)) ∧ ∀ z ∈ connectedComponentIn (regularSet T) y, ∃ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G ∧ z ∈ G ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ G → T₁ ω = c * T ω
